daily_summary.es: Apple despliega su estrategia de hogar inteligente con HomeView y Siri AI, mientras la computación distribuida de Apple y nuevos modelos de IA dominan la jornada técnica.
daily_summary.en: Apple rolls out its smart-home push with HomeView and Siri AI, while Apple's distributed computing work and new AI models lead the day's tech news.

apple.es: Apple presentó HomeView, una pantalla inteligente con Siri AI que reconoce hasta seis rostros, junto al HomePod mini 2, el nuevo Apple TV 4K con chip A19 y la Apple Home Collection desarrollada con LG Electronics y Schneider Electric, disponible desde diciembre. También llegaron las segundas Release Candidates de macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 y Tahoe 26.7.2, y nuevo firmware beta para varios modelos de AirPods.
apple.en: Apple unveiled HomeView, a smart display with Siri AI that recognizes up to six faces, alongside the HomePod mini 2, a new A19-powered Apple TV 4K, and the Apple Home Collection built with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric, arriving from December. Apple also shipped second release candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and Tahoe 26.7.2, plus new beta firmware for several AirPods models.

ai_software.es: Apple reveló Minions, un sistema que agrupa GPUs inactivas de sus Macs para crear una nube virtual de inferencia, reduciendo tiempos de espera de hasta diez horas a minutos. Gemini 4 Argon llegó a AI Gateway con ventana de contexto de 1M tokens para tareas de codificación agéntica, y un nuevo libro de Sam Newman aborda patrones de recuperación ante desastres para sistemas con IA.
ai_software.en: Apple revealed Minions, a system that pools idle GPUs across its Macs into a virtual inference cloud, cutting wait times from as long as ten hours down to minutes. Gemini 4 Argon landed on AI Gateway with a 1M-token context window for agentic coding work, and a new book by Sam Newman covers disaster-recovery patterns for AI-powered systems.

ai_general.es: Anthropic advirtió sobre riesgos de ciberataques del modelo abierto GLM-5.3, reavivando el debate sobre si los beneficios de los modelos abiertos compensan sus riesgos. Mientras tanto, laboratorios de IA compran datos de startups quebradas para entrenar modelos, y Google DeepMind incorporó a un filósofo residente para abordar la ética de la IA.
ai_general.en: Anthropic warned about cyberattack risks from the open-weight GLM-5.3 model, reviving debate over whether open models' benefits outweigh their risks. Meanwhile, AI labs are buying data from defunct startups to train models, and Google DeepMind brought on a resident philosopher to tackle AI ethics.

tech.es: Pluto Security recaudó 42 millones de dólares para abordar los riesgos de seguridad derivados del uso generalizado de IA en empresas, mientras Shopify amplía su catálogo a más agentes de IA y Google planea llevar apps generadas con IA a la Play Store. Ejecutivos de OpenAI y Anthropic pidieron a legisladores británicos que regulen la IA.
tech.en: Pluto Security raised $42 million to tackle security risks from widespread enterprise AI use, while Shopify expanded its catalog to more AI agents and Google plans to bring AI-generated apps to the Play Store. OpenAI and Anthropic executives asked British lawmakers to regulate AI.

title.es: Apple presenta HomeView, su primera pantalla inteligente con Siri AI
title.en: Apple unveils HomeView, its first smart display with Siri AI

body.es: Apple presentó HomeView, una pantalla inteligente de 7 pulgadas pensada para ser el centro del hogar, equipada con el chip A18 y una nueva versión de Siri mucho más conversacional. El dispositivo reconoce hasta seis rostros distintos para ofrecer contenido personal en Mensajes, FaceTime, Calendario, Recordatorios y Buscar, mientras que fotos compartidas y música siguen siendo accesibles para todos. Es la entrada de Apple en las pantallas inteligentes domésticas, un terreno dominado hasta ahora por Amazon y Google.
body.en: Apple unveiled HomeView, a 7-inch smart display designed to be the center of the home, powered by the A18 chip and a new, far more conversational version of Siri. The device recognizes up to six distinct faces to surface personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My, while shared photos and music remain accessible to everyone. It marks Apple's entry into smart home displays, a space long dominated by Amazon and Google.

evidence.claim: Apple HomeView is designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it.
HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational.
HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My.
Apple HomeView is equipped with the A18 chip, the same as in the iPhone 16 and 16 Plus.

title.es: Apple lanza de golpe cuatro novedades para el hogar: HomeView, HomePod mini 2, Apple TV 4K y Apple Home Collection
title.en: Apple drops four home products at once: HomeView, HomePod mini 2, Apple TV 4K, and Apple Home Collection

body.es: Apple completó su ofensiva doméstica con el HomePod mini 2 (chip S10, cinco colores), el Apple TV 4K 2026 con chip A19 y tvOS 27, y la Apple Home Collection, una gama de cámaras, timbre con vídeo, cerradura y termostatos fabricados junto a LG. El lanzamiento conjunto confirma que Apple quiere competir de forma integral en el hogar conectado, más allá de un solo dispositivo.
body.en: Apple rounded out its home push with the HomePod mini 2 (S10 chip, five colors), the 2026 Apple TV 4K with an A19 chip and tvOS 27, and the Apple Home Collection, a range of cameras, a video doorbell, a lock, and thermostats made with LG. The combined launch signals Apple's intent to compete broadly in the connected home, not just with a single device.

evidence.claim: Apple has launched HomeView, HomePod mini 2, Apple TV 4K, and Apple Home Collection.
HomeView is a smart screen with a 7-inch square display and Siri AI capabilities.
HomePod mini 2 has a new chip S10 and comes in five colors.
Apple TV 4K 2026 features the A19 chip and tvOS 27.
Apple Home Collection includes cameras, a doorbell with video, a lock, and thermostats.

title.es: Apple crea una nube de GPU virtual agrupando Macs inactivas para IA
title.en: Apple builds a virtual GPU cloud by pooling idle Macs for AI

body.es: Apple desarrolló Minions, un sistema distribuido que agrupa GPUs inactivas de sus propios Macs para crear una nube de inferencia tolerante a fallos, reduciendo tiempos de cola de hasta diez horas a minutos. El sistema consta de cuatro componentes —Minion Server, un almacén de metadatos en PostgreSQL, Minion Executor y Minion Watchdog— y prioriza la disponibilidad de hardware sobre el throughput, a diferencia de un clúster Nvidia típico.
body.en: Apple built Minions, a distributed system that pools idle GPUs across its own Macs to create a fault-tolerant inference cloud, cutting queue times from as long as ten hours down to minutes. The system has four components—Minion Server, a PostgreSQL metadata store, Minion Executor, and Minion Watchdog—and prioritizes hardware availability over throughput, unlike a typical Nvidia cluster.

evidence.claim: Apple has developed a distributed system called Minions to aggregate idle GPUs across its Macs for AI workloads.
Minions can reduce queue times for inference jobs from ten hours to minutes.
The Minions system is designed to create a virtual GPU cloud from connected Mac hardware.
Minions has four primary components: Minion Server, PostgreSQL Metadata Store, Minion Executor, and Minion Watchdog.
Apple's approach with Minions focuses on hardware availability and utilization rather than throughput, latency, and efficient GPU utilization for large models.

title.es: Apple se une a LG y Schneider Electric para la Apple Home Collection
title.en: Apple partners with LG and Schneider Electric for the Apple Home Collection

body.es: Apple confirmó una alianza con LG Electronics y Schneider Electric para fabricar la Apple Home Collection, que incluye sensores, termostatos, cámaras y una cerradura inteligente, con disponibilidad desde diciembre y hasta 2027. LG aporta un timbre con vídeo y una cámara tipo foco, ampliando el ecosistema de accesorios domésticos de Apple más allá del hardware propio.
body.en: Apple confirmed a partnership with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric to manufacture the Apple Home Collection, which includes sensors, thermostats, cameras, and a smart lock, arriving from December through 2027. LG is contributing a video doorbell and a floodlight-style camera, extending Apple's home accessory ecosystem beyond its own hardware.

evidence.claim: Apple has partnered with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric on the Apple Home Collection.
The Apple Home Collection includes sensors, thermostats, cameras, and a smart lock.
LG has developed a video doorbell and a floodlight camera for the Apple Home Collection.

title.es: Laboratorios de IA compran datos de startups quebradas para entrenar modelos
title.en: AI labs are buying data from defunct startups to train models

body.es: Empresas como SimpleClosure y Sunset ayudan a startups que cierran a vender su código y datos operativos —correos, chats, documentos— a laboratorios de IA, vendedores de entornos simulados y empresas tecnológicas. Google pagó 10 millones de dólares por décadas de datos de Spirit Airlines, incluidos 100 millones de correos y 176.000 registros de empleados, en una venta que sindicatos y abogados ya califican de legalmente delicada por la posible inclusión de información personal.
body.en: Companies like SimpleClosure and Sunset are helping shuttering startups sell their code and operational data—emails, chats, documents—to AI labs, simulated-workspace vendors, and tech companies. Google paid $10 million for decades of Spirit Airlines data, including 100 million emails and 176,000 employee records, in a sale that unions and lawyers already call legally fraught given the risk of embedded personal information.

evidence.claim: SimpleClosure, part of a new growth sector in tech, helps founders sell the code and workspace data of their dying startups.

Tech undertakers are selling the data remains to AI labs, with buyers including foundation AI labs, vendors that construct simulated workspaces for AI training, and mature tech companies building their own models.
The sale of data from dying startups has become increasingly routine, with 47% of SimpleClosure deals now including code or data sales.
Google outbid the AI data company Mercor to buy Spirit Airlines' decades of data, including 100 million emails, 500 million Teams messages, and 176,000 employee records, for $10 million.
The sale of data from dying startups could be legally problematic, with some private details potentially being included in the data.

title.es: Pluto Security capta 42 millones de dólares ante los nuevos riesgos de seguridad de la IA
title.en: Pluto Security raises $42 million as AI creates new security risks

body.es: Pluto Security levantó una ronda de 42 millones de dólares para atender un problema emergente: cuando todos en una empresa tienen acceso a herramientas de IA, el uso se vuelve impredecible y abre nuevos agujeros de seguridad. La financiación refleja la creciente preocupación corporativa por vulnerabilidades derivadas del uso masivo de IA en el lugar de trabajo.
body.en: Pluto Security raised a $42 million round to address an emerging problem: when everyone in a company has access to AI tools, usage becomes unpredictable and opens new security holes. The funding reflects growing corporate concern over vulnerabilities stemming from widespread AI use in the workplace.

evidence.claim: Giving everyone in a company access to AI tools can lead to unexpected usage.
Companies are concerned about new security vulnerabilities due to AI usage.

title.es: OpenAI y Anthropic piden a legisladores británicos que los regulen
title.en: OpenAI and Anthropic tell British lawmakers: regulate us

body.es: Líderes de IA se sumaron a denunciantes y responsables de seguridad en una amplia sesión parlamentaria en el Reino Unido, donde pidieron explícitamente una regulación del sector. El episodio marca un giro notable en el discurso público de las principales empresas de IA frente a los reguladores.
body.en: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security officials at a sweeping parliamentary session in the UK, where they explicitly called for regulation of the sector. The episode marks a notable shift in how leading AI companies are publicly framing their stance toward regulators.

evidence.claim: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security leaders at a parliamentary session.

title.es: Gemini 4 Argon llega a AI Gateway
title.en: Gemini 4 Argon arrives on AI Gateway

text.es: Gemini 4 Argon, orientado a codificación y razonamiento agéntico, ya está disponible en AI Gateway con ventana de contexto de 1M tokens, soporte para texto, imagen, PDF y vídeo, y llamadas a herramientas. AI Gateway ofrece una API unificada para gestionar modelos, costes y failover con mayor disponibilidad que los proveedores individuales.
text.en: Gemini 4 Argon, built for coding and agentic reasoning, is now available on AI Gateway with a 1M-token context window, support for text, image, PDF, and video input, and tool calling. AI Gateway provides a unified API for managing models, costs, and failover with higher uptime than individual providers.

evidence.claim: Gemini 4 Argon is built for coding, agentic work, and complex reasoning.
Gemini 4 Argon has a 1M token context window.
Gemini 4 Argon supports tool calling.
AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and configuring retries, failover, and performance optimizations for higher-than-provider uptime.

title.es: Shopify abre su catálogo a más agentes de IA
title.en: Shopify opens its catalog to more AI agents

text.es: Shopify amplió su función de comercio agéntico para que los clientes conecten un agente con su cuenta en Shop, la plataforma que centraliza pedidos y recomendaciones. Los pedidos realizados por el agente se canalizan de vuelta a la app Shop, y cada compra requiere la aprobación explícita del comprador.
text.en: Shopify expanded its agentic commerce feature so customers can connect an agent to their account on Shop, the platform that centralizes orders and recommendations. Orders placed through the agent are routed back to the Shop app, and every purchase requires explicit buyer approval.

evidence.claim: The expanded feature enables customers to connect an agent with their account on Shop, a Shopify-owned platform.
Orders placed through the agent are funneled back to the Shop app.
Buyers must approve each purchase.

title.es: Google quiere alojar tus apps 'vibe-coded' en la Play Store
title.en: Google wants to host your vibe-coded apps in the Play Store

text.es: Google planea ayudar a convertir apps personales generadas con IA en lanzamientos de distribución amplia dentro de la Play Store, abriendo una vía para que creaciones informales hechas con asistentes de codificación lleguen a un público mayor.
text.en: Google plans to help turn personal AI-generated apps into wide releases within the Play Store, opening a path for informal creations made with coding assistants to reach a broader audience.

evidence.claim: Google plans to help turn those personal AI-generated apps into wide releases.

title.es: Apple lanza las segundas Release Candidates de macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 y Tahoe 26.7.2
title.en: Apple releases second RCs for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and Tahoe 26.7.2

text.es: Apple publicó las segundas Release Candidates de macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 y macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, apenas una semana después de las primeras RCs, en un paso habitual previo al lanzamiento público de ambas actualizaciones.
text.en: Apple released the second release candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, just one week after the first RCs, a routine step ahead of the public rollout of both updates.

evidence.claim: Apple has released the second Release Candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2.

why_it_matters.es: Open SWE, construido por LangChain sobre Deep Agents, convierte el trabajo de ingeniería en un sistema repetible: investiga un repositorio, implementa cambios en un sandbox aislado, los valida y entrega un pull request, además de revisar PRs y monitorizar CI. Es relevante para desarrolladores que exploran agentes de codificación autónomos desplegables en su propia infraestructura.
why_it_matters.en: Open SWE, built by LangChain on Deep Agents, turns engineering work into a repeatable system: it investigates a codebase, implements changes in an isolated sandbox, validates them, and delivers a pull request, while also reviewing PRs and monitoring CI. It's relevant for developers exploring autonomous coding agents deployable on their own infrastructure.

trending_repos.name: hol-guard
trending_repos.description: Open-source antivirus for AI agents: block risky tools, secret access, prompt injection, malicious packages, MCP servers, plugins, and skills at runtime.

why_it_matters.es: HOL Guard es un antivirus de código abierto para agentes de IA que bloquea en tiempo de ejecución herramientas riesgosas, accesos a secretos, inyección de prompts, paquetes maliciosos y servidores MCP maliciosos. Con la proliferación de agentes autónomos con acceso a sistemas reales, esta capa de seguridad local-first aborda un vacío práctico de defensa.
why_it_matters.en: HOL Guard is an open-source antivirus for AI agents that blocks risky tools, secret access, prompt injection, malicious packages, and malicious MCP servers at runtime. As autonomous agents with access to real systems proliferate, this local-first security layer addresses a practical defense gap.

trending_repos.name: vibestart
trending_repos.description: Compose a full-stack TypeScript stack and get a cutting-edge, verified project made for AI coding agents, with type safety, lint, and tests built in. | 自由组合全栈 TypeScript 技术栈，得到一个前沿、经过验证、为 AI 编码智能体打造的项目，内置类型安全、lint 与测试。

why_it_matters.es: VibeStart permite componer una pila TypeScript full-stack y obtener un proyecto verificado, con seguridad de tipos, lint y tests integrados, pensado específicamente para que agentes de codificación de IA trabajen sobre una base de código consistente. Resulta útil para desarrolladores que buscan arrancar proyectos con una estructura que los agentes puedan mantener sin degradarse con el tiempo.
why_it_matters.en: VibeStart lets developers compose a full-stack TypeScript stack and get a verified project with type safety, lint, and tests built in, designed specifically so AI coding agents work on a consistent codebase. It's useful for developers who want to start projects with a structure that agents can maintain without eroding over time.
